This out-of-bounds read can cause crashes and may lead to information disclosure when processing malformed ELF files.

This memcpy-param-overlap triggers undefined behavior (MSAN/ASAN unknown reads), potentially causing memory corruption, crashes, and incorrect hashing results.

This memcpy-param-overlap triggers undefined behavior (MSAN/ASAN unknown reads), potentially causing memory corruption, crashes, and incorrect hashing results.
